meta.description: Use this when setting up claude-mem on Cursor: local or remote worker, local host-login observer or remote cmem.ai inference.

copy.tagline: 在 Cursor 中完成本地或远程的记忆服务配置，让 AI 助手记住上下文。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在 Cursor 里编程，希望 AI 助手能跨会话记住内容。
copy.tagline_en: Set up a memory service for Cursor with local or remote options.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code in Cursor and want your AI assistant to remember context.

howto.what: 在 Cursor 上安装 claude-mem:启动本地 worker(默认)或远程 worker,并接通 claude-mem-local 或 claude-mem-remote 这两个 MCP 服务。hooks 随插件附带,host/openrouter 模式不需要 Claude CLI,且与 Grok Bot 无关。
howto.when: 当你要在 Cursor 上配置 claude-mem 时触发,可选本地 worker(默认)或远程 worker。它与其他 IDE 无关,不依赖另一个 IDE。

say.text: 在 Cursor 上装 claude-mem,用默认的本地 worker
改成本地主机登录模式,加 --provider host

howto.what_en: Installs claude-mem on Cursor: starts a local worker (default) or remote worker and connects the claude-mem-local or claude-mem-remote MCP service. Hooks ship with the plugin; host/openrouter modes need no Claude CLI.
howto.when_en: Use when setting up claude-mem on Cursor. Choose the local worker (default) or a remote worker. It is independent of Grok Bot and does not require the other IDE.

say_en.text: Install claude-mem on Cursor with the default local worker
Switch to local host-login with the --provider host flag
say_en.note: Uses the loopback shim on port 37778

say_en.text: Set up the remote worker with server-url https://YOUR_HOST
